decided: The rule on what a ledger entry may rely on no longer says the reader of decision records finds entries that cite an exploration decision the AI itself wrote; it leaves that to the program's closing review.
alternatives: give the reader a check for who wrote a cited exploration decision, and tell it who wrote each one
why: The reader judges only whether a record's wording makes sense, and nothing records who wrote an exploration decision, so the promise could not be kept.

relies_on.title: A ledger entry names what it relies on

detail: Proposal walk of fresh W7, option D1; the requirement is carried as MODIFIED.
